candidates: When writing the introductory description for a doc block API reference page, include all significant visual and UI behaviors — not only the primary function but also layout position, responsive visibility thresholds (e.g., hidden below a specific pixel width), and any container or layout side effects.

When documenting parameters in API reference pages, describe the full behavioral consequences for each significant value: for boolean flags, explain any side effects that occur even when the feature is 'off' (e.g., whether an empty container is still rendered to preserve layout); for union types (e.g., `string | null | ReactElement`), describe how each type variant renders or behaves differently.
